notes.title: Achievements
notes.notes: We have added 16 achievements to Orifoldium! And don't worry, if you've already played through all the levels (except for the last one) you'll have the achievements unlocked immediately after you finish a level!

notes.title: Orifoldium is LIVE!
notes.notes: Wow! The most amazing of all puzzle games is now available! Can't wait to see everyone's puzzles.
